meta.certificate: l_nu != 0 on {e_i} union {e_i+e_j, i<j} implies EvenPartSeparating; chart dependent, and strictly stronger than coprime rigidity itself
meta.reading: a value at or below resolution_floor is NOT evidence of vanishing; structural zeros are named only where an exact reference predicts them
